sqlpipe v2.0 release notes

This release changes the `/v2/users` endpoint. The endpoint no longer returns a `name` field. The endpoint now returns a `first_name` field and a `last_name` field. This change is a breaking change. If your code reads the `name` field, update your code before you upgrade to v2.0.

Version 2.0 adds a new flag: `--incremental`. If you set the `--incremental` flag, sqlpipe copies only new rows and changed rows. If you do not set the flag, sqlpipe copies all rows.

Version 2.0 writes Parquet files 40% faster than version 1.0. The faster write speed applies to all Parquet output in this version.
